blocks.orig: The Whisper Serengeti is a tented camp nestled in the wilderness, surrounded by acacia trees, in the middle of the Serengeti National Park. The 10 ensuite tents are large and comfortable, and boast wooden floors, a verandah, and good-quality beds. This is an environmentally friendly camp using solar panels for its electricity and hot water. The qualified staff here are happy to share their Tanzanian culture and customs, thus offering you the best possible Serengeti experience.
blocks.html: Tucked away in the wilderness among acacia trees, The Whisper Serengeti is a tented camp right in the heart of Serengeti National Park. Its 10 ensuite tents are spacious and comfortable, with wooden floors, a verandah and good-quality beds. The camp is eco-friendly and relies on solar panels for its electricity and hot water. The qualified team are glad to share Tanzanian culture and customs with you, so you get the best possible Serengeti experience.
